ops.text: In yasyf/cc-slack, editing .claude/fragments/AGENTS.md/*.fragment.md fires a PreToolUse note saying to run 'cc-guides render' and commit the fragment with the rendered AGENTS.md, but the Guides CI check (cc-guides pr-check) refuses any PR that touches AGENTS.md: 'AGENTS.md is CI-owned (rendered by cc-guides) — edit .claude/fragments/AGENTS.md/ instead'. Following the hook failed PR #485 once. The local render also downgraded cc-guides.lock from 0.1.55 to 0.1.54 because the Sprite's cc-guides is older. The hook note should say CI renders AGENTS.md and that only the fragment gets committed.
